level1.title: Jesus Calms the Storm
level1.story: Jesus and His friends were in a boat. A big storm came, and Jesus was asleep! He woke up and said, "Peace, be still," and the storm stopped.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say to the storm?

activity.title: The boat in the storm
activity.intro: Color by number to finish the boat.

level2.title: Who Is This?
level2.story: When evening came, Jesus said, "Let us pass over to the other side." A great storm of wind arose, and the waves beat into the boat. Jesus was in the back, asleep on a pillow, and the disciples woke Him, saying, "Master, doth it not concern Thee that we perish?" Rising up, He rebuked the wind and said to the sea, "Peace, be still," and there was a great calm. Jesus said, "Why are you fearful? Have you not faith yet?"
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why were the disciples still afraid after the calm?
How can you trust Jesus in a hard time?
actions: Pray 'Jesus, I trust in You' when afraid
level2.prayer: Jesus, Lord of wind and sea, give me peace. Amen.

activity.title: Fix the words
activity.intro: Three words are wrong. Cross them out and write the right ones.
activity.text: Peace, be {quiet|still}. Why are you {angry|fearful}? Have you not {food|faith} yet?
